PC Errata 2013 slip of [[WED15-l7 'Septoid' Droid]]: A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the stat boxes and the deploy and forfeit numbers) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013). Source: Players Committee, ''Decipher Errata'' sheet (“Official text as of January 1, 2013”), [http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf DecipherErrata.pdf], PDF page 5; the PDF was made on 16 April 2013 (file metadata). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Internet Archive] (9 August 2016; SHA-1 of the archived file 3453cd4bee7d22faa58e3cfa492bea8021b2578c). Shown on [[WED15-l7 'Septoid' Droid (PC Errata 2013 slip)]].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-6/61/ANH-D-wed15l7septoiddroid-PC-Errata-2013-slip.png Internet Archive item].
